source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 1 (PDF 4-32), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 1 (Introduction to Software Development) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 What is software development as a process? Name its stages.
(Software development aik amal ke taur par kya hai? Is ke marahil (stages) ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Software development aik systematic (munazzam) amal hai jo user ki zarooraton ko software products mein badalta hai. Is ke stages: analysis, design, coding, testing aur deployment; har stage ki apni ahmiyat aur khaas skills aur tools hain.

book_ref.quote: It involves a series of stages, from initial analysis through design, coding, testing, and deployment

blocks.prompt:
2 Why is software development important? Give two examples.
(Software development kyun ahem hai? Do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Software development masail hal karta aur zindagi aasaan banata hai. Misalein: social media se dosto se rabta; banking apps se paise ka intezam (educational games se seekhna mazedar).

book_ref.quote: Software development is important because it helps solve problems and makes our lives easier

blocks.text: 1.2 Introduction to Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)

blocks.prompt:
3 Define Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
(Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: SDLC aik framework hai jo batata hai ke idare application ko shuru ke khayal (conception) se deployment aur maintenance tak kaise banate hain. Is ka maqsad waqt aur kharche ke andar achha software dena hai.

book_ref.quote: is a framework that defines the processes used by organizations to build an application

blocks.prompt:
4 What is a framework in software development? Give one example.
(Software development mein framework kya hai? Aik misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Framework concepts, practices aur tools ka standard aur reusable majmooa hai jo application banane ki buniyad aur pehle se bane hisse deta hai. Misal: websites ke liye Django (user login, database management, page templates tayyar).

book_ref.quote: It offers predefined components and architectures that facilitate the implementation of specific software functionalities

blocks.prompt:
5 Give two benefits of using a framework.
(Framework istemal karne ke do faide likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Developer sirf apni application ka khaas code likhta hai, aam hal dobara nahi banata (efficiency).
2. Consistency aur code reusability se software ki quality aur maintainability behtar hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Frameworks promote efficiency, consistency, and code reusability, thereby improving the overall quality and maintainability

blocks.prompt:
6 Name the stages of SDLC in their correct order.
(SDLC ke stages sahi tarteeb mein likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Requirement gathering (zarooratein jama karna)
2. Design
3. Development
4. Testing
5. Deployment
6. Maintenance (dekh bhaal)

book_ref.quote: The SDLC consists of several steps as shown in Figure 1.1

blocks.prompt:
7 Name three key activities of the requirement gathering phase.
(Requirement gathering phase ki teen ahem activities ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Interviews aur surveys: users se sawal aur feedback.
2. Observations: users ko maujooda system chalate dekhna.
3. Document review: maujooda reports aur user manuals dekhna.

book_ref.quote: Key activities in this phase include:

blocks.prompt:
8 You are developing a new app for a school. Whom would you ask during requirement gathering, and what would you ask?
(Aap school ke liye nayi app bana rahe hain. Requirement gathering mein kis se aur kya poochenge?)
blocks.explanation: App istemal karne walon aur stakeholders se: students, teachers aur administrators. Un se poochenge ke woh kaun se features chahte hain, taa ke un ki zarooratein aur tawaqqu maloom hon.

book_ref.quote: you might ask students, teachers, and administrators what features they would like to see

blocks.prompt:
9 Define functional requirements. Give two examples for a library management system.
(Functional requirements ki definition likhein. Library management system ki do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Functional requirements system ke khaas kaam batati hain, yani system kya karega. Misalein: users kitabein dhoond kar le sakein; system due date aur overdue kitabon ki ittila bheje.

book_ref.quote: These requirements outline what the system should do

blocks.prompt:
10 Define non-functional requirements. Name any four of their aspects.
(Non-functional requirements ki definition likhein. Un ke koi chaar pehlu likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Non-functional requirements system ki quality, performance ke miyar aur pabandiyan batati hain, yani system kaam kaise karega. Pehlu: usability, reliability, performance, security (aur scalability).

book_ref.quote: They include aspects like usability, reliability, performance, and security

blocks.prompt:
11 Write the usability and scalability requirements of a library management system.
(Library management system ki usability aur scalability requirements likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Usability: interface aasaan aur samajh mein aane wala ho, taa ke kam mehnat se kaam ho.
Scalability: system barhte users aur kitabon ko sambhal sake.

book_ref.quote: The user interface should be intuitive and easy to navigate

blocks.prompt:
12 Name the four activities carried out in the design phase.
(Design phase ki chaar activities ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Diagrams banana (jaise flowchart)
2. Models banana (jaise user interface ke mockups)
3. Architecture ka mansooba (majmooi dhancha)
4. Requirements wazeh karna (har hissa kya karega)

book_ref.quote: In the design phase, we plan out how the software will look and work

blocks.prompt:
13 What is meant by 'specify requirements' in the design phase?
(Design phase mein 'specify requirements' se kya muraad hai?)
blocks.explanation: Is ka matlab hai wazeh karna ke software ka har hissa kya karega, taa ke saare features plan hon aur koi cheez reh na jaye.

book_ref.quote: To define clearly what each part of the software needs to do

blocks.prompt:
14 What happens in the development phase of SDLC?
(SDLC ke development phase mein kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Software ki asal tayyari shuru hoti hai: programmers design specifications ko programming language mein code ki soorat mein likhte hain, code test karte, ghaltiyan theek karte aur dobara test karte hain.

book_ref.quote: programmers translate these specifications into a programming language

blocks.prompt:
15 What is testing in SDLC? Name the three kinds of testing it includes.
(SDLC mein testing kya hai? Is mein shamil teen qisam ki testing ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Testing software ke bugs aur ghaltiyan dhoondne ka amal hai; software ko mukhtalif halaat mein chalaya jata hai. Is mein functionality, performance aur compatibility testing shamil hain.

book_ref.quote: During testing, the software is run under various conditions to see if it behaves correctly

blocks.prompt:
16 What is functionality testing?
(Functionality testing kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Functionality testing yaqeeni banati hai ke software ke tamam features specifications ke mutabiq kaam karein.

book_ref.quote: Ensuring all features of the software work according to the specifications

blocks.prompt:
17 Define deployment. Name its steps.
(Deployment ki definition likhein. Is ke steps ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Deployment test shuda software ko users ke liye dastyab karna hai. Steps: installation, configuration (preferences, network settings, database connections) aur asal mahol mein testing.

book_ref.quote: This often involves several steps:

blocks.prompt:
18 Give the book's comparison for deploying software.
(Software deploy karne ke liye kitab ki tashbeeh likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Software deploy karna naya store kholne jaisa hai: sab tayyar hone par customers (users) ko product istemal karne ki dawat di jati hai.

book_ref.quote: Once everything is set up, you welcome customers (users) to start using your product

blocks.prompt:
19 Why is the maintenance phase needed?
(Maintenance phase ki zaroorat kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Maintenance (musalsal updates) se software theek chalta rehta hai aur users ki zaroorat ya technology ki tabdeeli ke mutabiq dhalta hai, jaise paude ki dekh bhaal.

book_ref.quote: This ensures the software continues to function correctly and adapts to any changes in user needs or technology

blocks.prompt:
20 What are software development methodologies? Why are they used?
(Software development methodologies kya hain? Inhein kyun istemal kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh software banane ke munazzam tareeqe hain jo planning, tayyari aur intezam ki rehnumai karte hain. In se kaam munazzam aur efficient hota hai aur achha software banta hai.

book_ref.quote: They help ensure that the development process is systematic, efficient, and produces high-quality software

blocks.prompt:
21 What are software process models? Write their importance.
(Software process models kya hain? Un ki ahmiyat likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Process models software lifecycle ke amal ki abstract (khayali) tasveer hain jo planning aur control ka framework deti hain. Ahmiyat: predictability, efficiency (kam zaya mehnat) aur quality.

book_ref.quote: They provide a framework for planning, structuring, and controlling the development of software systems

blocks.prompt:
22 What is the Waterfall Model? Name its phases.
(Waterfall Model kya hai? Is ke phases ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Waterfall Model linear aur sequential tareeqa hai jis mein har phase mukammal hone par agla shuru hota hai, wapas nahi jate. Phases: requirements, design, implementation, testing, deployment, maintenance.

book_ref.quote: where each phase of the project must be completed before the next one begins

blocks.prompt:
23 Give two benefits of the Waterfall Model.
(Waterfall Model ke do faide likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Saada aur samajhne mein aasaan, kyun ke phases wazeh hain.
2. Har phase aik waqt mein aik mukammal hota hai, is liye progress ka intezam aur nigrani aasaan hai.

book_ref.quote: Each phase is completed one at a time, which makes it easier to manage and track progress

blocks.prompt:
24 Why is the Waterfall Model not ideal for complex projects?
(Waterfall Model pechida projects ke liye munasib kyun nahi?)
blocks.explanation: Pechida projects ki requirements badalti rehti hain. Waterfall farz karta hai ke sab requirements shuru se maloom hain, aur mukammal phase mein wapas ja kar tabdeeli mushkil aur mehngi hai.

book_ref.quote: For projects with evolving requirements or complex designs, this model can be challenging to use effectively

blocks.prompt:
25 Differentiate between the Waterfall Model and Agile Methodology.
(Waterfall Model aur Agile Methodology mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Farq table mein diya gaya hai.

book_ref.quote: Unlike the Waterfall Model, which follows a strict sequence of steps

rows: Linear aur sequential tareeqa
Lachakdar (flexible) aur dhalne wala tareeqa
Har phase mukammal hone par agla shuru hota hai
Kaam chhote cycles (iterations ya sprints) mein hota hai
Wapas ja kar tabdeeli mushkil aur mehngi hai
Development shuru hone ke baad bhi tabdeeli mumkin hai
Farz karta hai ke sab requirements shuru se maloom hain
Requirements feedback se barhti badalti hain
Wazeh aur pakki requirements wale chhote projects ke liye
Chhote chalte hisse jaldi diye jate hain aur jaldi feedback milta hai

blocks.prompt:
26 What are iterations (sprints) in Agile? What is their benefit?
(Agile mein iterations (sprints) kya hain? Un ka faida kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Iterations ya sprints woh chhote cycles hain jin mein Agile ka kaam hota hai. In se software ke hisse jaldi milte hain aur feedback jaldi aata hai.

book_ref.quote: The main idea is to work in short cycles, called iterations or sprints

blocks.prompt:
27 What is pair programming?
(Pair programming kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pair programming Agile ki practice hai jis mein do developers aik workstation par kaam karte hain; aik code likhta hai aur doosra usi waqt jaanchta hai.

book_ref.quote: with one writing code and the other reviewing it in real-time

blocks.prompt:
28 What is test-driven development?
(Test-driven development kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Test-driven development Agile ki practice hai jis mein code likhne se pehle tests likhe jate hain, taa ke software theek kaam kare.

book_ref.quote: Writing tests before writing the code to ensure the software works as expected

blocks.prompt:
29 What is meant by the 'high flexibility' of Agile?
(Agile ki 'high flexibility' se kya muraad hai?)
blocks.explanation: Agile mein development shuru hone ke baad bhi requirements badli ja sakti hain, is liye nayi zaroorat ya feedback ke mutabiq dhalna aasaan hai.

book_ref.quote: Agile allows for changes in requirements even after development has started

blocks.prompt:
30 Write any two limitations of Agile Methodology.
(Agile Methodology ki koi do khamiyan likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Bare projects mein bohat si teams ka intezam mushkil hai.
2. Feedback aur tabdeeli ki wajah se waqt aur scope ka theek andaza mushkil hai. (Tamam stakeholders ki shirkat bhi zaroori hai.)

book_ref.quote: Managing large projects with many teams can be difficult

blocks.prompt:
31 What is Scrum? Why is it well suited for dynamic environments?
(Scrum kya hai? Yeh badalte mahol ke liye munasib kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Scrum aik agile framework hai jo pechida software projects ke intezam ke liye hai. Yeh iterative progress, mil jul kar kaam aur lachak deta hai, is liye bar bar badalti requirements mein munasib hai.

book_ref.quote: It promotes iterative progress, collaboration, and flexibility

blocks.prompt:
32 Differentiate between Product Backlog and Sprint Backlog.
(Product Backlog aur Sprint Backlog mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Farq table mein diya gaya hai.

book_ref.quote: Key artifacts in Scrum are the Product Backlog (a prioritized list of features and requirements)

rows: Product ke features aur requirements ki tarjeehi fehrist
Aik Sprint mein mukammal hone wale kaamon ki fehrist
Product Owner banata hai
Development Team maujooda Sprint ke liye leti hai
Poore product ke liye
Sirf aik Sprint ke liye

blocks.prompt:
33 Differentiate between the Product Owner and the Scrum Master.
(Product Owner aur Scrum Master mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Farq table mein diya gaya hai.

book_ref.quote: The Scrum Master facilitates the process, removes obstacles

rows: Product backlog banata hai
Scrum ke amal ko aasaan banata hai
Team ko sab se ahem kaamon par rakhta hai
Team ki rukawatein door karta hai
Tay karta hai pehle kya banega
Dekhta hai ke team Scrum practices par chale

blocks.prompt:
34 Why may Scrum not be suitable for embedded systems?
(Scrum embedded systems ke liye munasib kyun nahi ho sakta?)
blocks.explanation: Embedded systems mein hardware ka milap aur sakht qawaneen hote hain aur requirements kam badalti hain, is liye in ke liye linear tareeqa Scrum ke iterative tareeqe se behtar ho sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: which often involves hardware integration and stringent regulatory requirements

blocks.prompt:
35 What is Lean Software Development?
(Lean Software Development kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Lean Software Development aik iterative tareeqa hai jo efficiency, zaya khatam karne aur jaldi achha product dene par zor deta hai. Yeh Lean manufacturing se liya gaya hai aur customer ko value deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Lean Software Development is an iterative approach to software development that emphasizes efficiency

blocks.prompt:
36 Write any four key principles of Lean Software Development.
(Lean Software Development ke koi chaar ahem usool likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Eliminate waste: be-faida kaam hatao.
2. Amplify learning: musalsal behtari aur seekhna.
3. Decide as late as possible: taaza maloomat par faisla.
4. Deliver as fast as possible: chhote incremental features jaldi do.
(Baqi: empower the team, build integrity in, see the whole.)

book_ref.quote: Foster an environment of continuous improvement and learning

blocks.prompt:
37 Give one example of a project suitable for Lean and one not suitable for it.
(Lean ke liye munasib aur ghair munasib project ki aik aik misal dein.)
blocks.explanation:
Munasib: nayi mobile app banane wala startup, jo user feedback par jaldi badlav karta hai.
Ghair munasib: aviation control system ka software, jise sakht documentation, testing aur qawaneen ki pabandi chahiye.

book_ref.quote: a startup developing a new mobile app would benefit from Lean principles

blocks.prompt:
38 Define DevOps. What is its primary goal?
(DevOps ki definition likhein. Is ka bunyadi maqsad kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: DevOps practices ka majmooa hai jo software development (Dev) aur IT operations (Ops) ko jorta hai. Maqsad: lifecycle chhota karna, quality behtar karna aur qabil-e-aitmaad musalsal delivery.

book_ref.quote: to enhance collaboration, efficiency, and agility in delivering software products and services

blocks.prompt:
39 How does DevOps improve efficiency and quality?
(DevOps efficiency aur quality kaise behtar karta hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Efficiency: bar bar hone wale kaam automatic hone se haath ki mehnat aur insani ghalti kam hoti hai.
Quality: musalsal testing aur nigrani se masail jaldi pakre jate hain.

book_ref.quote: Automation of repetitive tasks reduces manual effort and the risk of human error

blocks.prompt:
40 Why is planning a software project compared to planning a trip?
(Software project ki planning ko safar ki planning se kyun milaya gaya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dono mein maloom hona chahiye ke kahan jana hai (maqsad), kitna waqt lagega (timeline) aur kitna kharcha hoga (budget).

book_ref.quote: You need to know where you're going, how long it will take, and how much it will cost

blocks.prompt:
41 What is comprehensive project planning?
(Comprehensive project planning kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Is ka matlab hai project shuru karne se pehle tamam tafseelat sochna: kya karna hai, kaun karega aur kaise karega.

book_ref.quote: This includes understanding what needs to be done, who will do it, and how it will be done

blocks.prompt:
42 What is meant by setting project timelines? Give an example.
(Project timelines set karne se kya muraad hai? Misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Har hisse ka waqt tay karna taa ke project waqt par mukammal ho. Misal: website ke design, content likhne aur testing ke liye alag alag waqt.

book_ref.quote: If you're building a website, you might set a timeline for designing the site

blocks.prompt:
43 What is cost estimation of a software project? Why is it important?
(Software project ki cost estimation kya hai? Yeh kyun ahem hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cost estimation project ke kul kharche ka pehle se andaza hai. Durust andaza budget, resources ki taqseem aur haqeeqat pasand tawaqqu mein madad deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Accurate cost estimation helps in budgeting, resource allocation, and setting realistic expectations

blocks.prompt:
44 How do the technology stack and project duration affect the cost of a project?
(Technology stack aur project ki muddat laagat par kaise asar daalti hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Technology stack: kuch technologies ko zyada resources ya khaas ilm chahiye, is liye laagat barhti hai.
Muddat: lamba project zyada der resources leta hai aur scope badal sakta hai, is liye mehnga.

book_ref.quote: Some technologies require more resources or specialized knowledge

blocks.prompt:
45 A project needs 3 QA testers at PKR 2,500/hour, each working 20 hours/week for 12 weeks. Find their cost.
(Project mein 3 QA testers PKR 2,500 fi ghanta par, har aik 20 ghante haftawar, 12 hafte kaam karte hain. Laagat maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Laagat = testers x rate x ghante haftawar x hafte
= 3 x PKR 2,500 x 20 x 12
= PKR 1,800,000

book_ref.quote: QA Testers: 2 testers x PKR 2,500/hour

blocks.prompt:
46 Name the three types of risks a software project can face, with one example of each.
(Software project ko darpesh teen qisam ke risks aik aik misal ke saath likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Technical risks, jaise technology ki tabdeeli.
2. Operational risks, jaise resources ki kami.
3. External risks, jaise market ka utaar charhao.

book_ref.quote: List all potential risks that could affect the project

blocks.prompt:
47 What is a mitigation strategy? Give two ways to reduce a risk.
(Mitigation strategy kya hai? Risk kam karne ke do tareeqe likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Mitigation strategy kisi bare risk ka imkaan ya asar kam karne ka mansooba hai. Tareeqe: schedule mein gunjaish rakhna, backup resources, ya mazeed testing (jaise nayi technology ke liye pilot project).

book_ref.quote: This could involve adding buffers to the schedule, securing backup resources, or conducting additional testing

blocks.prompt:
48 Define quality assurance. Give one example.
(Quality assurance ki definition likhein. Aik misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Quality assurance yaqeeni banati hai ke project tay shuda miyar par poora utre aur theek chale (testing, code review, feedback, progress ki jaanch). Misal: code durust likha ho aur theek chale.

book_ref.quote: In a software project, this involves ensuring that the code is both accurately written and functions as expected

blocks.prompt:
49 Why is graphical representation of software systems used?
(Software systems ki graphical representation kyun istemal hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Diagrams software ka dhancha aur rawayya dikhati hain. Is se pechida system aasaan ho jata hai aur developers aur stakeholders ke liye samajhna aur rabta aasaan hota hai.

book_ref.quote: This approach helps in simplifying complex systems

blocks.prompt:
50 Define UML. Why is it important?
(UML ki definition likhein. Yeh kyun ahem hai?)
blocks.explanation: UML (Unified Modeling Language) software design ko dekhne ka standard tareeqa hai. Yeh pechida systems ko samajhna aur sambhalna aasaan banata hai.

book_ref.quote: UML is important because it makes complex systems easier to understand and manage

blocks.prompt:
51 Name the four types of UML diagrams discussed in the chapter.
(Chapter mein di gayi UML diagrams ki chaar qismon ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Use case diagram
2. Class diagram
3. Sequence diagram
4. Activity diagram

book_ref.quote: four types of the UML diagrams that are give below

blocks.prompt:
52 What is a use case?
(Use case kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Use case user (actor) aur system ke darmiyan kisi khaas maqsad ke liye hone wale rabton ki tafseel hai; har use case user ki nazar se aik mukammal kaam hai.

book_ref.quote: A use case is a description of a set of interactions between a user (actor) and a system to achieve a specific goal

blocks.prompt:
53 Write the steps of identifying use cases.
(Use cases pehchanne ke steps likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Actors pehchanein.
2. Har actor ke maqsad tay karein.
3. Actors aur system ke rabte likhein.
4. Stakeholders ke saath use cases ki tasdeeq karein.

book_ref.quote: The process of identifying use cases involves several steps:

blocks.prompt:
54 In the online shopping platform, list the use cases of the Administrator and of the Delivery Personnel.
(Online shopping platform mein Administrator aur Delivery Personnel ke use cases likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Administrator: manage product listings, process orders, handle customer inquiries.
Delivery Personnel: update delivery status.

book_ref.quote: the platform includes features for administrators to manage product listings, process orders, and handle customer inquiries

blocks.prompt:
55 Differentiate between a use case diagram and a class diagram.
(Use case diagram aur class diagram mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Farq table mein diya gaya hai.

book_ref.quote: These diagrams provide a visual representation of the system's functionality from the user's perspective

rows: Users (actors) aur system ka rabta dikhati hai
System ki cheezon ki tarteeb aur aapas ka taalluq dikhati hai
User ki nazar se system ke kaam dikhati hai
Dhancha dikhati hai: classes, attributes aur methods
Bunyadi hisse: actors aur use cases
Bunyadi hisse: classes (boxes), attributes, methods
Misal: Customer, Make Purchase
Misal: Box, ToyBox, open(), close()

blocks.prompt:
56 What is a class diagram? Explain it with the room example.
(Class diagram kya hai? Kamre ki misal se samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation: Class diagram aik naqshe ki tarah hai jo system ki cheezon ki tarteeb aur taalluq dikhata hai. Kamre ki misal mein kamra poora dhancha, box class, box ki cheezein attributes aur open/close methods hain; ToyBox, BookBox, ClothesBox khaas boxes hain.

book_ref.quote: A class diagram is like a map that shows how things are organized in a system

blocks.prompt:
57 What is a sequence diagram? Name the interactions in the book's room example.
(Sequence diagram kya hai? Kitab ki kamre wali misal ke interactions likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Sequence diagram dikhati hai ke objects aik khaas tarteeb mein aapas mein kaise rabta karte hain. Misal: open() box kholna; put toys/books/clothes inside cheezein daalna; close() box band karna.

book_ref.quote: Sequence Diagrams show how objects in a system interact with each other in a particular sequence

blocks.prompt:
58 What is an activity diagram? Give the book's restaurant example.
(Activity diagram kya hai? Kitab ki restaurant wali misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Activity diagram kisi amal ke qadmon ka bahao dikhati hai. Restaurant misal: Start, Order Placement, Food Preparation, Order Delivery, End; teer tarteeb dikhate hain.

book_ref.quote: In a restaurant management system, an activity diagram can represent the process

blocks.text: 1.5.3 Using UML to Represent Software Systems

blocks.prompt:
59 Give three practical applications of UML in software development.
(Software development mein UML ke teen amli istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Planning: code se pehle requirements aur design ka naqsha.
2. Development: developers dhancha aur taalluqat samajhte hain.
3. Communication: ghair-technical log bhi system samajhte hain.

book_ref.quote: UML can be used in various stages of software development to improve understanding and communication

blocks.prompt:
60 What are design patterns?
(Design patterns kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Design patterns software ke aam masail ke azmaaye hue hal hain. Yeh blueprint ya template hain jinhein zaroorat ke mutabiq dhala ja sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: They serve as blueprints or templates that can be adapted to solve various design challenges

blocks.prompt:
61 Name four commonly used design patterns.
(Chaar aam istemal hone wale design patterns ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Singleton pattern
2. Factory pattern
3. Observer pattern
4. Strategy pattern

book_ref.quote: Below are some of the most widely recognized design patterns

blocks.prompt:
62 Explain the Singleton pattern with the book's example.
(Singleton pattern ko kitab ki misal se samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation: Singleton pattern mein koi object program mein sirf aik dafa banta hai aur har jagah wahi istemal hota hai. Jaise khaas kamre ki aik hi chaabi jo sab istemal karte hain; nayi chaabi nahi banti.

book_ref.quote: Think of it like having just one key to a special room

blocks.prompt:
63 Differentiate between the Singleton pattern and the Factory pattern.
(Singleton pattern aur Factory pattern mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Farq table mein diya gaya hai.

book_ref.quote: The Factory Design Pattern is like having a special workshop that knows how to create different products

rows: Object sirf aik dafa banta hai
Maangne par mukhtalif products (objects) banata hai
Wahi object har dafa dobara istemal hota hai
Zaroorat batayein aur tayyar product lein
Misal: khaas kamre ki aik chaabi jo sab istemal karte hain
Misal: khaas workshop jo mukhtalif cheezein banati hai

blocks.prompt:
64 Explain the Observer pattern.
(Observer pattern samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation: Observer pattern mein dilchaspi rakhne wale aik source se updates lete hain. Kuch ahem ho to source khud sab ko ittila deta hai, is liye kisi ko bar bar check nahi karna parta.

book_ref.quote: The Observer Design Pattern is like having a group of people who are interested in getting updates

blocks.prompt:
65 Explain the Strategy pattern.
(Strategy pattern samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation: Strategy pattern aik toolbox jaisa hai jis mein har kaam ka alag aozaar hai. Masle ke kai hal hote hain; kaam ke mutabiq sahi hal chunein aur aasani se badlein.

book_ref.quote: When you face a problem, you can pick the right tool from the box based on the task at hand

blocks.text: 1.6.2 Applications of Design Patterns in Software Design

blocks.prompt:
66 Give three ways in which design patterns help in software design.
(Design patterns software design mein teen tarah kaise madad dete hain?)
blocks.explanation:
1. Wazeh dhancha de kar code ki pechidgi kam karte hain.
2. Azmaaye hue hal se code reusability barhate hain.
3. Mushtarka zabaan (vocabulary) se developers ka rabta behtar karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Design patterns are widely used in software development to solve common problems

blocks.prompt:
67 Define debugging. How are bugs identified and solved?
(Debugging ki definition likhein. Bugs kaise pehchane aur hal kiye jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Debugging software ke bugs dhoondna aur theek karna hai. Software ka rawayya dekh kar masle ki jarr dhoondi jati hai, phir code badal kar ghalti durust ki jati hai.

book_ref.quote: Identifying bugs involves observing the software's behavior and finding the source of the problem

blocks.prompt:
68 Name three tools or best practices for debugging.
(Debugging ke teen tools ya behtareen tareeqe likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Debuggers: code qadam ba qadam chalana aur variables dekhna.
2. Print statements: mukhtalif jagah variables ki values dikhana.
3. Code reviews: doosre developers code jaanchte hain.

book_ref.quote: There are various tools and best practices for debugging, including:

blocks.prompt:
69 Differentiate between debugging and testing.
(Debugging aur testing mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Farq table mein diya gaya hai.

book_ref.quote: Testing is the process of evaluating the software to ensure it meets the requirements and works as expected

rows: Software ke bugs dhoondna aur theek karna
Software ko jaanchna ke requirements poori kare aur theek chale
Code badal kar bug hal hota hai
Chhote hisson se poore system tak darja ba darja hoti hai
Debuggers, print statements aur code reviews
Darje: unit, integration, system, acceptance

blocks.prompt:
70 What is a 'unit' in unit testing? What is the goal of unit testing?
(Unit testing mein 'unit' kya hai? Unit testing ka maqsad kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Unit software ka chhota qabil-e-test hissa hai, jaise function ya method. Maqsad: har component apne design ke mutabiq theek kaam kare.

book_ref.quote: The primary goal of unit testing is to verify that each component works correctly

blocks.prompt:
71 Differentiate between unit testing and integration testing.
(Unit testing aur integration testing mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Farq table mein diya gaya hai.

book_ref.quote: While unit testing focuses on isolated units, integration testing ensures that these units work together correctly when combined

rows: Testing ka pehla darja
Unit testing ke baad hoti hai
Har component ya module alag test hota hai
Mile hue modules ka aapas ka rabta test hota hai
Har unit (function ya method) ka theek kaam check hota hai
Interface errors aur modules ke darmiyan data ka bahao check hota hai

blocks.prompt:
72 What is system testing? What does it evaluate?
(System testing kya hai? Is mein kya jaancha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: System testing mein poora software production jaise mahol mein test hota hai. Is ki functionality, performance, security aur requirements ki pabandi jaanchi jati hai.

book_ref.quote: testers evaluate its overall functionality, performance, security, and compliance with specified requirements

blocks.prompt:
73 Differentiate between system testing and acceptance testing.
(System testing aur acceptance testing mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Farq table mein diya gaya hai.

book_ref.quote: Acceptance testing can be formal or informal and typically includes scenarios that mimic real-world usage

rows: Poora software aik kul ke taur par test hota hai
Aakhri darja; tay hota hai ke software release ke liye tayyar hai
Testers karte hain
Aksar end-users ya clients karte hain
Functionality, performance, security aur requirements check
Users ki tawaqqu: usability, reliability, performance
Production jaise mahol mein
Asal istemal jaise scenarios mein

blocks.prompt:
74 What are software development tools? Name any four.
(Software development tools kya hain? Koi chaar ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh programs ya applications hain jo software banane ke marahil mein madad dete hain: code likhna, ghaltiyan theek karna, project sambhalna. Misalein: editors, translators, debuggers, IDEs, repositories.

book_ref.quote: These tools help developers write code, find and fix errors, and manage software projects effectively

blocks.prompt:
75 What is the purpose of a language editor? Give two examples.
(Language editor ka maqsad kya hai? Do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Language (code) editors code likhne aur edit karne mein madad dete hain; maqsad code likhne ke liye aasaan interface dena hai. Misalein: Notepad++, Sublime Text (VS Code bhi).

book_ref.quote: The purpose of language editors is to provide a user-friendly interface for writing code

blocks.prompt:
76 Differentiate between an interpreter and a compiler.
(Interpreter aur compiler mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Farq table mein diya gaya hai.

book_ref.quote: Compilers: Translate the entire code at once (e.g., GCC for C/C++)

rows: Code line ba line tarjuma karta hai
Poora code aik saath tarjuma karta hai
Misal: Python interpreter
Misalein: C/C++ ke liye GCC, Java ke liye Javac

blocks.prompt:
77 What is the purpose of a compiler? Give two examples.
(Compiler ka maqsad kya hai? Do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Compiler poore program ko chalne se pehle machine code mein badalta hai; maqsad code ko behtar aur efficient machine code banana hai. Misalein: GCC (C/C++), Javac (Java).

book_ref.quote: The purpose of compilers is to optimize and convert code into efficient machine code

blocks.prompt:
78 What is a debugger? Give two examples.
(Debugger kya hai? Do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Debuggers code ke bugs dhoondne aur theek karne ke tools hain; yeh batate hain ghalti kahan hai. Misalein: GDB (C/C++) aur Visual Studio Debugger.

book_ref.quote: The purpose of debuggers is to allow developers to test their code

blocks.prompt:
79 What is an IDE? Name three common IDEs.
(IDE kya hai? Teen aam IDEs ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: IDE (Integrated Development Environment) aisa software hai jo editor, compiler, debugger aur version control ko aik interface mein jama karta hai. Misalein: Eclipse (Java), Visual Studio (.NET, C++), PyCharm (Python).

book_ref.quote: An IDE offers a unified interface where developers can write, test, and debug their code efficiently

blocks.prompt:
80 Differentiate between online and offline computing platforms.
(Online aur offline computing platforms mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Farq table mein diya gaya hai.

book_ref.quote: Local development environments on a computer (e.g., local installations of IDEs)

rows: Cloud par, internet ke zariye
Apne computer par maqami mahol
Misalein: Repl.it, Gitpod
Misal: computer par install IDEs

blocks.prompt:
81 What are source code repositories? Give two examples.
(Source code repositories kya hain? Do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Repositories woh platforms hain jahan developers code mehfooz karte, sambhalte aur tabdeeliyon ka record rakhte hain (version control). Misalein: GitHub, Bitbucket.

book_ref.quote: Source code repositories are platforms where developers can store, manage, and track changes to their code
